mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, ROUND(AVG(scenery_score), 1) as avgSceneryScore, ROUND(AVG(fun_score), 1) as avgFunScore, ROUND(AVG(value_score), 1) as avgValueScore, ROUND(AVG(overall_score), 1) as avgOverallScore, SUM(CASE WHEN overall_score >= 4.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fiveStarCount, SUM(CASE WHEN overall_score >= 3.5 AND overall_score < 4.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fourStarCount, SUM(CASE WHEN overall_score >= 2.5 AND overall_score < 3.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as threeStarCount, SUM(CASE WHEN overall_score >= 1.5 AND overall_score < 2.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as twoStarCount, SUM(CASE WHEN overall_score > 0 AND overall_score < 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as oneStarCount FROM attraction_rating WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND overall_score > 0

SELECT r.id, r.attraction_id AS attractionId, r.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, r.overall_score AS overallScore, r.comment, r.create_time AS createTime FROM attraction_rating r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND r.comment IS NOT NULL AND r.comment != '' ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
